verdict.rationale: Browser Use is a cloud service with user accounts, sessions, profiles and run history, so an account-wide data export is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no feature for exporting all user data in open formats. The CSV example (gh-2) is a task the agent performs on third-party websites. The events API and the open-source library are developer building blocks or alternatives, not a first-party data-export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
